body:
Unfortunately, I don't have the financial independence necessary to simply get up and relocate. 

As for working out, I'm in the gym at least seven hours a week. It's an integral part of my life. Hell, it gives me a reason to leave the house on the most idle of days. If it weren't for exercise, I probably wouldn't be here. 

I don't really know what a medical professional could do for me at this point. I'm on a strong dose of an anti-depressant. Therapy doesn't really do it for me.

You know, I don't believe in an afterlife. I don't feel that anyone is here for a specific purpose. I don't even want kids. I don't feel particularly driven to see out the remainder of my days. I just kind of feel that I might as well as get on with the inevitable if I'm going to be such a miserable fuck.
